name: Trail Gunner
summary: Trail Gunner; Your first ranged hit on each of your turns deals +1d4 damage while no hostile creature is adjacent to you.  Trail Gunner; Your Trail Gunner damage becomes +1d6.  Trail Gunner; When you score a critical hit with a ranged attack, the target is Suppressed until your next turn.  Trail Gunner; Your Trail Gunner damage becomes +1d8, and that hit ignores light cover.
descriptionMarkdown:
Trail Gunner; Your first ranged hit on each of your turns deals +1d4 damage while no hostile creature is adjacent to you.
